changes.range_policy: single byte range, suffix and open-ended supported, end clipped to object length, invalid/multiple/unsatisfiable rejected after authorization
changes.if_range_policy: ignored, current immutable representation is used for the requested Range
changes.authorization: current session, owner, purpose, exact asset revision, expiry and ancestor revocation on every request and every bounded storage block

changes.ticket_policy: opaque reusable ticket within its lifetime, bound to one current session, security epoch, resource revision and download purpose
changes.receipt: asset_id reference only, secret ticket omitted
changes.migration: dedicated media_tickets table, existing authentication challenges retain their existing semantics

cache_policy: no-store remains the exact public response value defined by 0.2.0; authorization applies to every read

data_mapping.retention: unassigned is an explicit pending policy marker; audio commit remains disabled until PR-04b supplies an approved policy authority
data_mapping.first_cloud_received_at: preserved from the immutable object's storage LastModified, including database-failure recovery

compatibility: existing JSON DTOs and upload paths remain compatible; additional binary responses require consumer Range handling; no generated frontend type change before contract review
positive_cases: fresh ticket on idempotent access retry
